goal: Offline inspect reports every V1 semantic object from a reproducible local Python environment without writes or network access.
non_goals: Do not implement ValidationContext, typed templates, RenderPlan or DOCX capabilities in this slice.
Do not promote HTML prototype code into production.
Do not introduce network, API key, database or AI dependencies.
Do not remove or merge existing detailed tasks.
expected_evidence: Project-local virtual environment and editable installation
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: Existing parser behavior is correct without expanded tests.
Parser may calculate final numbering or import rendering modules.
Global Python tools count as reproducible project-local evidence.
AppleDouble files may be deleted without a separate cleanup decision.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation needs files outside the allowed list, changes a product or syntax contract without documentation, or couples Parser/Domain to rendering, UI, AI or network behavior.
